abstract: Apple's interface design and fluid-motion principles translated to the web platform. 17 sections covering response latency, direct manipulation, interruptibility, spring behavior (damping/response), velocity handoff, momentum projection, spatial consistency, rubber-banding, gesture design, frame-level smoothness, translucent materials and depth, multimodal feedback, reduced motion, typography (optical sizing, tracking, leading), the eight Apple design principles, and prototyping process. Distilled from Apple WWDC design sessions; examples are CSS, Pointer Events, requestAnimationFrame, and Motion/Framer Motion.
